info.title: Golang CMS API
info.description: A content management system API built with Go, featuring JWT authentication with refresh tokens, password reset by email, and user profile management. Request bodies are limited to 1 MB (413 when larger).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Login, token refresh, logout, and password reset

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Role-based access control: roles, permissions, and the roles of a user. A user can only create, change, delete, assign or remove a role whose permissions they all hold.

get.description: Returns the health status of the service
Pings the database with a short timeout. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable, so a load balancer stops routing traffic to this instance.
Returns the API version, the time the server started, and its uptime

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password. After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes. Rate limited per client IP.

400.description: Validation error, or invalid credentials (code 3002). Unknown emails, wrong passwords and locked accounts all get this same answer; an account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.

post.description: Exchange a refresh token and the (possibly expired) access token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The old refresh token is invalidated. Rate limited per client IP.

401.description: Invalid access token, invalid refresh token, or tokens belong to different users

429.description: Too many requests - per-IP rate limit of 10 requests per minute exceeded

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time at which the window resets

post.description: Sends a password reset link (valid for 1 hour) to the email address if it belongs to a user. The response is the same whether or not the email exists. Rate limited per client IP.

message.example: If your email is in our system, you will receive instructions to reset your password
